ko.title: G20 미국 개최: 무역, 부채, AI 분야의 관전 포인트

segments.src: The United States is set to host this year's Group of 20 leaders' summit in Florida next month.
segments.tr: 미국은 다음 달 플로리다에서 올해 G20 정상회의를 개최할 예정이다.

segments.src: The meeting brings together the world's largest economies at a tense moment for the global economy.
segments.tr: 이번 회의는 세계 경제가 긴장된 시기에 세계 최대 경제국들을 한자리에 모은다.

segments.src: Tariffs, heavy government debt and the fast spread of artificial intelligence are all competing for attention.
segments.tr: 관세, 막대한 정부 부채, 인공지능의 빠른 확산 등이 모두 주목을 받기 위해 경쟁하고 있다.

segments.src: This guide covers what is on the table, where the major economies disagree, and what the talks could mean for markets and household budgets.
segments.tr: 이 가이드는 논의될 의제, 주요 경제국 간의 이견, 그리고 이번 회담이 시장과 가계 예산에 어떤 의미를 가질 수 있는지 다룬다.

segments.src: *Note: Summit schedules, guest lists and agenda items can change.
segments.tr: *참고: 정상회의 일정, 초청 명단 및 의제는 변경될 수 있다.

segments.src: Check official government announcements for the latest details.*
segments.tr: 최신 세부 사항은 공식 정부 발표를 확인하라.*

segments.src: ## Why this summit matters
segments.tr: ## 이번 정상회의가 중요한 이유

segments.src: The G20 includes the United States, China, the European Union, Japan, India, Germany, the United Kingdom, Brazil and other major economies.
segments.tr: G20에는 미국, 중국, 유럽연합, 일본, 인도, 독일, 영국, 브라질 및 기타 주요 경제국이 포함된다.

segments.src: Together they account for the large majority of global economic output and trade.
segments.tr: 이들은 전 세계 경제 생산량과 무역의 대다수를 차지한다.

segments.src: The group has no power to pass binding laws.
segments.tr: 이 그룹은 구속력 있는 법을 통과시킬 권한은 없다.

segments.src: Its value comes from putting leaders in one room, setting shared priorities and nudging national policies in the same direction.
segments.tr: 그 가치는 지도자들을 한자리에 모으고, 공동의 우선순위를 설정하며, 국가 정책을 같은 방향으로 유도하는 데 있다.

segments.src: Hosting the summit gives Washington a chance to shape the agenda.
segments.tr: 정상회의를 주최함으로써 워싱턴은 의제를 형성할 기회를 얻는다.

segments.src: It also puts the host under close scrutiny, since many partners have criticized recent U.S.
segments.tr: 또한 많은 파트너 국가들이 최근 미국의

segments.src: trade policy.
segments.tr: 무역 정책을 비판해 왔기 때문에 주최국으로서 면밀한 조사를 받게 된다.

segments.src: ## Trade: the central tension
segments.tr: ## 무역: 핵심적인 긴장 요소

segments.src: Trade is likely to dominate the conversation.
segments.tr: 무역이 대화의 주를 이룰 것으로 보인다.

segments.src: Over the past few years, higher tariffs and shifting trade rules have changed how goods move around the world.
segments.tr: 지난 몇 년간, 더 높은 관세와 변화하는 무역 규칙은 전 세계 상품 이동 방식을 바꾸어 놓았다.

segments.src: Several themes are likely to come up:
segments.tr: 몇 가지 주제가 논의될 가능성이 높다:

segments.src: - **Tariffs and retaliation.** Governments are weighing how far to go with import taxes and how to respond when others raise theirs.
segments.tr: - **관세 및 보복.** 각국 정부는 수입 관세를 어디까지 인상할지, 그리고 다른 국가들이 관세를 인상할 때 어떻게 대응할지를 저울질하고 있다.

segments.src: - **Supply chains.** Many companies are moving production closer to home or to friendlier countries, which can raise costs in the short run.
segments.tr: - **공급망.** 많은 기업이 생산 시설을 본국 근처나 우호적인 국가로 이전하고 있으며, 이는 단기적으로 비용을 상승시킬 수 있다.

segments.src: - **The role of the World Trade Organization.** Leaders disagree on whether its rules still work and how they should be updated.
segments.tr: - **세계무역기구(WTO)의 역할.** 지도자들은 WTO의 규칙이 여전히 유효한지, 그리고 어떻게 업데이트되어야 하는지에 대해 의견이 갈린다.

segments.src: - **Critical minerals and technology.** Access to rare earths, advanced chips and batteries has become a matter of national security as well as commerce.
segments.tr: - **핵심 광물 및 기술.** 희토류, 첨단 칩, 배터리에 대한 접근은 상업뿐만 아니라 국가 안보의 문제가 되었다.

segments.src: Expect plenty of talks on the sidelines between individual leaders.
segments.tr: 개별 지도자들 간의 부대 회담도 많이 열릴 것으로 예상된다.

segments.src: Those side meetings sometimes produce more concrete results than the group communiqué does.
segments.tr: 이러한 부대 회담이 때로는 그룹 공동 성명보다 더 구체적인 결과를 낳기도 한다.

segments.src: ## Debt: a slow-burning pressure
segments.tr: ## 부채: 서서히 타오르는 압박

segments.src: Government borrowing is another major topic.
segments.tr: 정부 차입 또한 주요 주제이다.

segments.src: Many advanced economies carry debt levels well above where they stood before the pandemic.
segments.tr: 많은 선진국이 팬데믹 이전보다 훨씬 높은 수준의 부채를 안고 있다.

segments.src: Higher interest rates make that debt more expensive to service.
segments.tr: 금리 인상은 부채 상환 비용을 더 비싸게 만든다.

segments.src: Poorer countries face an even sharper problem, since some spend more on interest payments than on health or education.
segments.tr: 빈곤국들은 보건이나 교육보다 이자 지급에 더 많은 돈을 쓰는 경우가 있어 훨씬 더 심각한 문제에 직면해 있다.

segments.src: Possible discussion points include:
segments.tr: 가능한 논의 지점은 다음과 같다:

segments.src: 1. How to restructure debt for low-income countries faster and more fairly.
segments.tr: 1. 저소득 국가의 부채를 더 빠르고 공정하게 재조정하는 방법.

segments.src: 2. The role of large lenders, including China, other governments and private creditors.
segments.tr: 2. 중국, 기타 정부 및 민간 채권자를 포함한 대형 대출 기관의 역할.

segments.src: 3. Whether wealthy countries can keep their own borrowing on a sustainable path.
segments.tr: 3. 부유한 국가들이 자체 차입을 지속 가능한 경로로 유지할 수 있는지 여부.

segments.src: 4. Support for development banks and the International Monetary Fund.
segments.tr: 4. 개발 은행 및 국제통화기금(IMF)에 대한 지원.

segments.src: Progress here tends to be gradual.
segments.tr: 이 분야의 진전은 점진적인 경향이 있다.

segments.src: A realistic outcome is a statement of principles or a small step on coordination, not a sweeping deal.
segments.tr: 현실적인 결과는 포괄적인 합의가 아니라 원칙에 대한 성명이나 조정에 관한 작은 조치일 것이다.

segments.src: ## Artificial intelligence: new rules, new rivalries
segments.tr: ## 인공지능: 새로운 규칙, 새로운 경쟁

segments.src: AI has moved from a niche topic to a core economic issue.
segments.tr: AI는 틈새 주제에서 핵심 경제 이슈로 부상했다.

segments.src: Leaders are expected to discuss how to encourage investment and innovation while managing risks such as job disruption, misinformation and security threats.
segments.tr: 지도자들은 일자리 중단, 허위 정보, 보안 위협과 같은 위험을 관리하면서 투자와 혁신을 장려하는 방법을 논의할 것으로 예상된다.

segments.src: Governments take different approaches.
segments.tr: 정부마다 접근 방식이 다르다.

segments.src: Some prefer light regulation to speed up growth, while others favor firmer rules on safety and transparency.
segments.tr: 일부는 성장을 가속하기 위해 가벼운 규제를 선호하는 반면, 다른 일부는 안전과 투명성에 대해 더 엄격한 규칙을 선호한다.

segments.src: Energy is part of the story too.
segments.tr: 에너지 또한 이 이야기의 일부이다.

segments.src: Data centers use a lot of electricity, and countries are competing to secure the power, chips and talent needed to lead in the technology.
segments.tr: 데이터 센터는 많은 전력을 사용하며, 각국은 기술 분야를 선도하기 위해 필요한 전력, 칩, 인재를 확보하기 위해 경쟁하고 있다.

segments.src: Agreement on common standards would be a notable result, though differences between the major powers make a broad binding pact unlikely.
segments.tr: 공통 표준에 대한 합의는 주목할 만한 결과가 되겠지만, 주요 강대국 간의 차이로 인해 광범위한 구속력 있는 협정은 가능성이 낮다.

segments.src: ## Where the major economies disagree
segments.tr: ## 주요 경제국 간의 이견

segments.src: - **U.S. and China:** Trade, technology controls and market access remain the biggest points of friction.
segments.tr: - **미국과 중국:** 무역, 기술 통제, 시장 접근성은 여전히 가장 큰 마찰 지점이다.

segments.src: - **U.S. and Europe:** Disagreements over tariffs, digital regulation and climate policy could surface.
segments.tr: - **미국과 유럽:** 관세, 디지털 규제, 기후 정책에 대한 이견이 표면화될 수 있다.

segments.src: - **Advanced and emerging economies:** Countries in the Global South want a bigger voice on debt relief, climate finance and the rules of global trade.
segments.tr: - **선진국과 신흥 경제국:** 글로벌 사우스(Global South) 국가들은 부채 탕감, 기후 금융, 세계 무역 규칙에 대해 더 큰 목소리를 내기를 원한다.

segments.src: - **Geopolitics:** Ongoing conflicts and sanctions can shape the tone of the meetings and make a joint final statement harder to reach.
segments.tr: - **지정학:** 지속되는 갈등과 제재는 회의 분위기를 형성하고 공동 최종 성명 도출을 더 어렵게 만들 수 있다.

segments.src: In past years, disagreement has sometimes meant that leaders could not agree on a full joint communiqué.
segments.tr: 지난 몇 년간, 의견 불일치로 인해 지도자들이 완전한 공동 성명에 합의하지 못한 경우도 있었다.

segments.src: The host may instead issue a chair's summary or narrower statements on topics where consensus exists.
segments.tr: 대신 주최국은 의장 요약문이나 합의가 존재하는 주제에 대한 더 좁은 범위의 성명을 발표할 수 있다.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for markets
segments.tr: ## 시장에 미칠 수 있는 의미

segments.src: Investors usually watch the G20 for signals, not for surprises.
segments.tr: 투자자들은 보통 G20에서 놀라움이 아닌 신호를 찾는다.

segments.src: Clear signs of easing trade tensions could support stocks and reduce currency swings.
segments.tr: 무역 긴장 완화의 명확한 신호는 주가를 지지하고 통화 변동을 줄일 수 있다.

segments.src: A breakdown in talks, or new tariff threats, could do the opposite.
segments.tr: 회담 결렬이나 새로운 관세 위협은 정반대의 결과를 초래할 수 있다.

segments.src: Bond markets may pay attention to any language about debt and fiscal discipline.
segments.tr: 채권 시장은 부채와 재정 규율에 관한 모든 언사에 주목할 수 있다.

segments.src: Technology and energy companies will watch the AI discussions for hints about future rules and investment.
segments.tr: 기술 및 에너지 기업들은 향후 규칙과 투자에 대한 힌트를 얻기 위해 AI 논의를 지켜볼 것이다.

segments.src: Market moves around such events are often short-lived.
segments.tr: 이러한 이벤트 전후의 시장 움직임은 종종 단기적이다.

segments.src: Economic data, central bank decisions and corporate earnings usually matter more over time.
segments.tr: 경제 데이터, 중앙은행 결정, 기업 실적이 시간이 지남에 따라 더 중요하다.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for everyday prices
segments.tr: ## 일상 물가에 미칠 수 있는 의미

segments.src: For households, the effect is indirect and slow.
segments.tr: 가계에 미치는 영향은 간접적이고 느리다.

segments.src: A few ways the summit's topics can reach your budget:
segments.tr: 정상회의 주제가 예산에 영향을 미칠 수 있는 몇 가지 방법:

segments.src: - **Tariffs** can raise the prices of imported goods such as electronics, clothing, cars and some groceries. A deal that lowers them could eventually ease costs, while escalation could add to them.
segments.tr: - **관세**는 전자제품, 의류, 자동차, 일부 식료품과 같은 수입품 가격을 인상할 수 있다. 관세를 낮추는 합의는 결국 비용을 완화할 수 있지만, 확대되면 비용이 추가될 수 있다.

segments.src: - **Interest rates** are affected by government borrowing and inflation expectations, which influence mortgage, auto loan and credit card rates.
segments.tr: - **금리**는 정부 차입과 인플레이션 기대치에 영향을 받으며, 이는 주택 담보 대출, 자동차 대출, 신용 카드 금리에 영향을 미친다.

segments.src: - **Supply chain stability** affects how reliably products reach store shelves and how much they cost.
segments.tr: - **공급망 안정성**은 제품이 매장 진열대에 얼마나 안정적으로 도달하는지, 그리고 비용이 얼마나 드는지에 영향을 미친다.

segments.src: - **AI and jobs** may reshape hiring, wages and the services people use, although the timeline is uncertain.
segments.tr: - **AI와 일자리**는 채용, 임금 및 사람들이 사용하는 서비스를 재편할 수 있지만, 그 시기는 불확실하다.

segments.src: None of these effects happens overnight, and a summit statement alone does not change prices.
segments.tr: 이러한 영향 중 어느 것도 하룻밤 사이에 일어나지 않으며, 정상회의 성명만으로는 가격이 변하지 않는다.

segments.src: What matters is whether leaders follow words with policy.
segments.tr: 중요한 것은 지도자들이 말에 이어 정책을 실행하느냐이다.

segments.src: ## What to look for
segments.tr: ## 주목해야 할 점

segments.src: When the summit ends, a few questions will help you judge how it went:
segments.tr: 정상회의가 끝나면, 회의가 어떻게 진행되었는지 판단하는 데 도움이 될 몇 가지 질문이 있다:

segments.src: 1. Did leaders agree on a joint declaration, or only on partial statements?
segments.tr: 1. 지도자들이 공동 선언에 합의했는가, 아니면 부분적인 성명에만 합의했는가?

segments.src: 2. Were there concrete commitments on trade, such as timelines or specific rule changes?
segments.tr: 2. 일정이나 구체적인 규칙 변경과 같은 무역에 대한 구체적인 약속이 있었는가?

segments.src: 3. Did any progress on debt relief come with real funding or procedures?
segments.tr: 3. 부채 탕감에 대한 진전이 실제 자금 지원이나 절차와 함께 이루어졌는가?

segments.src: 4. Was there agreement on shared principles for AI?
segments.tr: 4. AI에 대한 공유 원칙에 합의가 있었는가?

segments.src: 5. Did leaders hold bilateral meetings that signal a thaw, or a deeper split?
segments.tr: 5. 지도자들이 해빙을 알리는 양자 회담을 가졌는가, 아니면 더 깊은 분열을 보였는가?

segments.src: The G20 rarely delivers dramatic breakthroughs.
segments.tr: G20이 극적인 돌파구를 마련하는 경우는 드물다.

segments.src: Its influence usually shows up in the months afterward, as governments act on what they agreed to, or fail to.
segments.tr: 그 영향력은 보통 그 후 몇 달 동안 정부가 합의한 내용을 이행하거나 이행하지 못할 때 나타난다.

segments.src: This year's meeting on American soil will test whether the world's largest economies can find common ground in a period of rising friction.
segments.tr: 미국 땅에서 열리는 올해 회의는 갈등이 고조되는 시기에 세계 최대 경제국들이 공통점을 찾을 수 있을지 시험대가 될 것이다.

zh.title: G20峰会来到美国：关注贸易、债务和人工智能议题

segments.src: The United States is set to host this year's Group of 20 leaders' summit in Florida next month.
segments.tr: 美国定于下个月在佛罗里达州主办今年的二十国集团（G20）领导人峰会。

segments.src: The meeting brings together the world's largest economies at a tense moment for the global economy.
segments.tr: 此次会议在全球经济处于紧张时刻之际，将世界各大经济体汇聚在一起。

segments.src: Tariffs, heavy government debt and the fast spread of artificial intelligence are all competing for attention.
segments.tr: 关税、沉重的政府债务以及人工智能的快速传播都在争夺人们的关注。

segments.src: This guide covers what is on the table, where the major economies disagree, and what the talks could mean for markets and household budgets.
segments.tr: 本指南涵盖了会议的议题、主要经济体之间的分歧，以及这些会谈对市场和家庭预算可能意味着什么。

segments.src: *Note: Summit schedules, guest lists and agenda items can change.
segments.tr: *注：峰会日程、嘉宾名单和议程项目可能会有变动。

segments.src: Check official government announcements for the latest details.*
segments.tr: 请查看政府官方公告以获取最新详情。*

segments.src: ## Why this summit matters
segments.tr: ## 为什么这次峰会很重要

segments.src: The G20 includes the United States, China, the European Union, Japan, India, Germany, the United Kingdom, Brazil and other major economies.
segments.tr: G20成员包括美国、中国、欧盟、日本、印度、德国、英国、巴西和其他主要经济体。

segments.src: Together they account for the large majority of global economic output and trade.
segments.tr: 它们共同占据了全球经济产出和贸易的绝大部分。

segments.src: The group has no power to pass binding laws.
segments.tr: 该组织无权通过具有约束力的法律。

segments.src: Its value comes from putting leaders in one room, setting shared priorities and nudging national policies in the same direction.
segments.tr: 其价值在于让领导人齐聚一堂，设定共同的优先事项，并推动各国政策朝着同一方向发展。

segments.src: Hosting the summit gives Washington a chance to shape the agenda.
segments.tr: 主办峰会给了华盛顿一个塑造议程的机会。

segments.src: It also puts the host under close scrutiny, since many partners have criticized recent U.S.
segments.tr: 这也使东道主受到密切审视，因为许多合作伙伴批评了美国近期的

segments.src: trade policy.
segments.tr: 贸易政策。

segments.src: ## Trade: the central tension
segments.tr: ## 贸易：核心紧张点

segments.src: Trade is likely to dominate the conversation.
segments.tr: 贸易很可能主导此次对话。

segments.src: Over the past few years, higher tariffs and shifting trade rules have changed how goods move around the world.
segments.tr: 过去几年里，更高的关税和不断变化的贸易规则改变了商品在全球的流动方式。

segments.src: Several themes are likely to come up:
segments.tr: 可能会出现几个主题：

segments.src: - **Tariffs and retaliation.** Governments are weighing how far to go with import taxes and how to respond when others raise theirs.
segments.tr: - **关税与报复。** 各国政府正在权衡在进口税方面走多远，以及当其他国家提高关税时该如何应对。

segments.src: - **Supply chains.** Many companies are moving production closer to home or to friendlier countries, which can raise costs in the short run.
segments.tr: - **供应链。** 许多公司正在将生产转移到离本土更近或更友好的国家，这在短期内可能会增加成本。

segments.src: - **The role of the World Trade Organization.** Leaders disagree on whether its rules still work and how they should be updated.
segments.tr: - **世界贸易组织的角色。** 领导人对于其规则是否仍然有效以及应如何更新存在分歧。

segments.src: - **Critical minerals and technology.** Access to rare earths, advanced chips and batteries has become a matter of national security as well as commerce.
segments.tr: - **关键矿产与技术。** 获取稀土、先进芯片和电池已成为国家安全以及商业问题。

segments.src: Expect plenty of talks on the sidelines between individual leaders.
segments.tr: 预计领导人之间将进行大量的场边会谈。

segments.src: Those side meetings sometimes produce more concrete results than the group communiqué does.
segments.tr: 这些双边会晤有时比小组公报产生更具体的结果。

segments.src: ## Debt: a slow-burning pressure
segments.tr: ## 债务：缓慢燃烧的压力

segments.src: Government borrowing is another major topic.
segments.tr: 政府借贷是另一个主要议题。

segments.src: Many advanced economies carry debt levels well above where they stood before the pandemic.
segments.tr: 许多发达经济体的债务水平远高于疫情前的水平。

segments.src: Higher interest rates make that debt more expensive to service.
segments.tr: 更高的利率使得偿还这些债务的成本更高。

segments.src: Poorer countries face an even sharper problem, since some spend more on interest payments than on health or education.
segments.tr: 较贫穷的国家面临更严峻的问题，因为它们在利息支付上的支出比在医疗或教育上的支出还要多。

segments.src: Possible discussion points include:
segments.tr: 可能的讨论点包括：

segments.src: 1. How to restructure debt for low-income countries faster and more fairly.
segments.tr: 1. 如何更快、更公平地重组低收入国家的债务。

segments.src: 2. The role of large lenders, including China, other governments and private creditors.
segments.tr: 2. 大型贷款机构（包括中国、其他政府和私人债权人）的角色。

segments.src: 3. Whether wealthy countries can keep their own borrowing on a sustainable path.
segments.tr: 3. 富裕国家能否保持自身借贷的可持续性。

segments.src: 4. Support for development banks and the International Monetary Fund.
segments.tr: 4. 对开发银行和国际货币基金组织的支持。

segments.src: Progress here tends to be gradual.
segments.tr: 这方面的进展往往是渐进的。

segments.src: A realistic outcome is a statement of principles or a small step on coordination, not a sweeping deal.
segments.tr: 现实的结果是一份原则声明或在协调上迈出一小步，而不是达成一项全面的协议。

segments.src: ## Artificial intelligence: new rules, new rivalries
segments.tr: ## 人工智能：新规则，新竞争

segments.src: AI has moved from a niche topic to a core economic issue.
segments.tr: 人工智能已从一个小众话题转变为核心经济议题。

segments.src: Leaders are expected to discuss how to encourage investment and innovation while managing risks such as job disruption, misinformation and security threats.
segments.tr: 预计领导人将讨论如何在鼓励投资和创新的同时，管理就业中断、虚假信息和安全威胁等风险。

segments.src: Governments take different approaches.
segments.tr: 各国采取不同的方法。

segments.src: Some prefer light regulation to speed up growth, while others favor firmer rules on safety and transparency.
segments.tr: 一些国家倾向于轻度监管以加速增长，而另一些国家则赞成在安全和透明度方面制定更严格的规则。

segments.src: Energy is part of the story too.
segments.tr: 能源也是其中的一部分。

segments.src: Data centers use a lot of electricity, and countries are competing to secure the power, chips and talent needed to lead in the technology.
segments.tr: 数据中心消耗大量电力，各国正在竞相确保在技术领域领先所需的电力、芯片和人才。

segments.src: Agreement on common standards would be a notable result, though differences between the major powers make a broad binding pact unlikely.
segments.tr: 就共同标准达成一致将是一个显著的成果，尽管大国之间的分歧使得达成广泛的约束性协议的可能性不大。

segments.src: ## Where the major economies disagree
segments.tr: ## 主要经济体的分歧所在

segments.src: - **U.S. and China:** Trade, technology controls and market access remain the biggest points of friction.
segments.tr: - **美国与中国：** 贸易、技术管制和市场准入仍然是最大的摩擦点。

segments.src: - **U.S. and Europe:** Disagreements over tariffs, digital regulation and climate policy could surface.
segments.tr: - **美国与欧洲：** 在关税、数字监管和气候政策方面的分歧可能会浮出水面。

segments.src: - **Advanced and emerging economies:** Countries in the Global South want a bigger voice on debt relief, climate finance and the rules of global trade.
segments.tr: - **发达经济体与新兴经济体：** 全球南方的国家希望在债务减免、气候融资和全球贸易规则方面拥有更大的发言权。

segments.src: - **Geopolitics:** Ongoing conflicts and sanctions can shape the tone of the meetings and make a joint final statement harder to reach.
segments.tr: - **地缘政治：** 持续的冲突和制裁可能会影响会议的基调，并使达成联合最终声明变得更加困难。

segments.src: In past years, disagreement has sometimes meant that leaders could not agree on a full joint communiqué.
segments.tr: 在过去几年中，分歧有时意味着领导人无法就一份完整的联合公报达成一致。

segments.src: The host may instead issue a chair's summary or narrower statements on topics where consensus exists.
segments.tr: 东道主可能会转而发布主席总结或在存在共识的话题上发表较窄范围的声明。

segments.src: ## What it could mean for markets
segments.tr: ## 这对市场可能意味着什么

segments.src: Investors usually watch the G20 for signals, not for surprises.
segments.tr: 投资者通常关注G20以获取信号，而不是为了寻找惊喜。

segments.src: Clear signs of easing trade tensions could support stocks and reduce currency swings.
segments.tr: 贸易紧张局势缓解的明确迹象可能会支撑股市并减少货币波动。

segments.src: A breakdown in talks, or new tariff threats, could do the opposite.
segments.tr: 会谈破裂或新的关税威胁可能会产生相反的效果。

segments.src: Bond markets may pay attention to any language about debt and fiscal discipline.
segments.tr: 债券市场可能会关注任何关于债务和财政纪律的措辞。

segments.src: Technology and energy companies will watch the AI discussions for hints about future rules and investment.
segments.tr: 科技和能源公司将关注人工智能讨论，以获取有关未来规则和投资的暗示。

segments.src: Market moves around such events are often short-lived.
segments.tr: 围绕此类事件的市场波动往往是短暂的。

segments.src: Economic data, central bank decisions and corporate earnings usually matter more over time.
segments.tr: 从长远来看，经济数据、央行决策和企业盈利通常更重要。

segments.src: ## What it could mean for everyday prices
segments.tr: ## 这对日常价格可能意味着什么

segments.src: For households, the effect is indirect and slow.
segments.tr: 对于家庭来说，影响是间接且缓慢的。

segments.src: A few ways the summit's topics can reach your budget:
segments.tr: 峰会议题影响你预算的几种方式：

segments.src: - **Tariffs** can raise the prices of imported goods such as electronics, clothing, cars and some groceries. A deal that lowers them could eventually ease costs, while escalation could add to them.
segments.tr: - **关税**可能会提高电子产品、服装、汽车和部分食品杂货等进口商品的价格。降低关税的协议最终可能会降低成本，而升级关税可能会增加成本。

segments.src: - **Interest rates** are affected by government borrowing and inflation expectations, which influence mortgage, auto loan and credit card rates.
segments.tr: - **利率**受政府借贷和通胀预期的影响，这会影响抵押贷款、汽车贷款和信用卡利率。

segments.src: - **Supply chain stability** affects how reliably products reach store shelves and how much they cost.
segments.tr: - **供应链稳定性**影响产品到达商店货架的可靠性以及它们的成本。

segments.src: - **AI and jobs** may reshape hiring, wages and the services people use, although the timeline is uncertain.
segments.tr: - **人工智能和就业**可能会重塑招聘、工资和人们使用的服务，尽管时间表尚不确定。

segments.src: None of these effects happens overnight, and a summit statement alone does not change prices.
segments.tr: 这些影响都不会在一夜之间发生，单凭一份峰会声明并不能改变价格。

segments.src: What matters is whether leaders follow words with policy.
segments.tr: 重要的是领导人是否会用政策来落实他们的言论。

segments.src: ## What to look for
segments.tr: ## 需要关注什么

segments.src: When the summit ends, a few questions will help you judge how it went:
segments.tr: 峰会结束后，以下几个问题将帮助你判断会议的效果：

segments.src: 1. Did leaders agree on a joint declaration, or only on partial statements?
segments.tr: 1. 领导人是否就联合宣言达成了一致，还是仅达成了部分声明？

segments.src: 2. Were there concrete commitments on trade, such as timelines or specific rule changes?
segments.tr: 2. 在贸易方面是否有具体的承诺，例如时间表或具体的规则变更？

segments.src: 3. Did any progress on debt relief come with real funding or procedures?
segments.tr: 3. 债务减免方面的任何进展是否伴随着实际的资金或程序？

segments.src: 4. Was there agreement on shared principles for AI?
segments.tr: 4. 是否就人工智能的共同原则达成了共识？

segments.src: 5. Did leaders hold bilateral meetings that signal a thaw, or a deeper split?
segments.tr: 5. 领导人是否举行了双边会晤，释放出关系缓和或分歧加深的信号？

segments.src: The G20 rarely delivers dramatic breakthroughs.
segments.tr: G20很少能带来戏剧性的突破。

segments.src: Its influence usually shows up in the months afterward, as governments act on what they agreed to, or fail to.
segments.tr: 其影响力通常在随后的几个月里显现，取决于各国政府是否采取行动落实他们同意的事项，或者未能落实。

segments.src: This year's meeting on American soil will test whether the world's largest economies can find common ground in a period of rising friction.
segments.tr: 今年在美国本土举行的会议将考验世界各大经济体在摩擦加剧的时期能否找到共同点。

segments.src: ## Why this summit matters
segments.tr: ## यह शिखर सम्मेलन क्यों महत्वपूर्ण है

segments.src: The G20 includes the United States, China, the European Union, Japan, India, Germany, the United Kingdom, Brazil and other major economies.
segments.tr: G20 में संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका, चीन, यूरोपीय संघ, जापान, भारत, जर्मनी, यूनाइटेड किंगडम, ब्राजील और अन्य प्रमुख अर्थव्यवस्थाएं शामिल हैं।

segments.src: Together they account for the large majority of global economic output and trade.
segments.tr: एक साथ मिलकर वे वैश्विक आर्थिक उत्पादन और व्यापार के एक बड़े हिस्से का प्रतिनिधित्व करते हैं।

segments.src: The group has no power to pass binding laws.
segments.tr: समूह के पास बाध्यकारी कानून पारित करने की कोई शक्ति नहीं है।

segments.src: Its value comes from putting leaders in one room, setting shared priorities and nudging national policies in the same direction.
segments.tr: इसका मूल्य नेताओं को एक ही कमरे में लाने, साझा प्राथमिकताओं को निर्धारित करने और राष्ट्रीय नीतियों को एक ही दिशा में आगे बढ़ाने में है।

segments.src: Hosting the summit gives Washington a chance to shape the agenda.
segments.tr: शिखर सम्मेलन की मेजबानी वाशिंगटन को एजेंडा तय करने का अवसर देती है।

segments.src: It also puts the host under close scrutiny, since many partners have criticized recent U.S.
segments.tr: यह मेजबान को बारीक निगरानी में भी रखता है, क्योंकि कई भागीदारों ने हाल ही में U.S.

segments.src: trade policy.
segments.tr: व्यापार नीति की आलोचना की है।

segments.src: ## Trade: the central tension
segments.tr: ## व्यापार: मुख्य तनाव

segments.src: Trade is likely to dominate the conversation.
segments.tr: व्यापार पर बातचीत हावी रहने की संभावना है।

segments.src: Over the past few years, higher tariffs and shifting trade rules have changed how goods move around the world.
segments.tr: पिछले कुछ वर्षों में, उच्च शुल्कों और बदलते व्यापार नियमों ने दुनिया भर में वस्तुओं की आवाजाही के तरीके को बदल दिया है।

segments.src: Several themes are likely to come up:
segments.tr: कई विषयों पर चर्चा होने की संभावना है:

segments.src: - **Tariffs and retaliation.** Governments are weighing how far to go with import taxes and how to respond when others raise theirs.
segments.tr: - **शुल्क और जवाबी कार्रवाई।** सरकारें इस बात का आकलन कर रही हैं कि आयात करों के साथ कितनी दूर तक जाना है और जब अन्य देश अपने शुल्क बढ़ाते हैं तो कैसे प्रतिक्रिया देनी है।

segments.src: - **Supply chains.** Many companies are moving production closer to home or to friendlier countries, which can raise costs in the short run.
segments.tr: - **आपूर्ति श्रृंखलाएं (सप्लाई चेन्स)।** कई कंपनियां उत्पादन को अपने देश के पास या अधिक मित्रवत देशों में स्थानांतरित कर रही हैं, जिससे कम अवधि में लागत बढ़ सकती है।

segments.src: - **The role of the World Trade Organization.** Leaders disagree on whether its rules still work and how they should be updated.
segments.tr: - **विश्व व्यापार संगठन (WTO) की भूमिका।** नेता इस बात पर असहमत हैं कि क्या इसके नियम अभी भी काम करते हैं और उन्हें कैसे अपडेट किया जाना चाहिए।

segments.src: - **Critical minerals and technology.** Access to rare earths, advanced chips and batteries has become a matter of national security as well as commerce.
segments.tr: - **महत्वपूर्ण खनिज और प्रौद्योगिकी।** दुर्लभ खनिजों, उन्नत चिप्स और बैटरियों तक पहुंच वाणिज्य के साथ-साथ राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा का मामला बन गई है।

segments.src: Expect plenty of talks on the sidelines between individual leaders.
segments.tr: व्यक्तिगत नेताओं के बीच द्विपक्षीय बातचीत की भी पूरी उम्मीद रखें।

segments.src: Those side meetings sometimes produce more concrete results than the group communiqué does.
segments.tr: वे पक्षीय बैठकें कभी-कभी समूह की आधिकारिक विज्ञप्ति (कम्यूनिके) की तुलना में अधिक ठोस परिणाम देती हैं।

segments.src: ## Debt: a slow-burning pressure
segments.tr: ## ऋण: एक धीरे-धीरे सुलगता हुआ दबाव

segments.src: Government borrowing is another major topic.
segments.tr: सरकारी उधार एक अन्य प्रमुख विषय है।

segments.src: Many advanced economies carry debt levels well above where they stood before the pandemic.
segments.tr: कई उन्नत अर्थव्यवस्थाओं पर ऋण का स्तर महामारी से पहले के स्तर से काफी अधिक है।

segments.src: Higher interest rates make that debt more expensive to service.
segments.tr: उच्च ब्याज दरें उस ऋण को चुकाना और भी महंगा बना देती हैं।

segments.src: Poorer countries face an even sharper problem, since some spend more on interest payments than on health or education.
segments.tr: गरीब देशों को इससे भी अधिक गंभीर समस्या का सामना करना पड़ता है, क्योंकि कुछ देश स्वास्थ्य या शिक्षा की तुलना में ब्याज भुगतान पर अधिक खर्च करते हैं।

segments.src: Possible discussion points include:
segments.tr: संभावित चर्चा के बिंदुओं में शामिल हैं:

segments.src: 1. How to restructure debt for low-income countries faster and more fairly.
segments.tr: 1. कम आय वाले देशों के लिए ऋण का पुनर्गठन तेजी से और अधिक निष्पक्ष तरीके से कैसे किया जाए।

segments.src: 2. The role of large lenders, including China, other governments and private creditors.
segments.tr: 2. चीन, अन्य सरकारों और निजी ऋणदाताओं सहित बड़े ऋणदाताओं की भूमिका।

segments.src: 3. Whether wealthy countries can keep their own borrowing on a sustainable path.
segments.tr: 3. क्या अमीर देश अपने स्वयं के उधार को एक टिकाऊ पथ पर रख सकते हैं।

segments.src: 4. Support for development banks and the International Monetary Fund.
segments.tr: 4. विकास बैंकों और अंतर्राष्ट्रीय मुद्रा कोष (IMF) के लिए सहायता।

segments.src: Progress here tends to be gradual.
segments.tr: यहाँ प्रगति धीरे-धीरे होने की प्रवृत्ति रखती है।

segments.src: A realistic outcome is a statement of principles or a small step on coordination, not a sweeping deal.
segments.tr: एक यथार्थवादी परिणाम सिद्धांतों का एक बयान या समन्वय पर एक छोटा सा कदम हो सकता है, कोई व्यापक समझौता नहीं।

segments.src: ## Artificial intelligence: new rules, new rivalries
segments.tr: ## आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस: नए नियम, नई प्रतिद्वंद्विताएं

segments.src: AI has moved from a niche topic to a core economic issue.
segments.tr: AI एक विशिष्ट (नीश) विषय से हटकर एक मुख्य आर्थिक मुद्दा बन गया है।

segments.src: Leaders are expected to discuss how to encourage investment and innovation while managing risks such as job disruption, misinformation and security threats.
segments.tr: उम्मीद है कि नेता नौकरियों में व्यवधान, गलत सूचना और सुरक्षा खतरों जैसे जोखिमों को प्रबंधित करते हुए निवेश और नवाचार को कैसे प्रोत्साहित किया जाए, इस पर चर्चा करेंगे।

segments.src: Governments take different approaches.
segments.tr: सरकारें अलग-अलग दृष्टिकोण अपनाती हैं।

segments.src: Some prefer light regulation to speed up growth, while others favor firmer rules on safety and transparency.
segments.tr: कुछ विकास को गति देने के लिए हल्के विनियमन को प्राथमिकता देते हैं, जबकि अन्य सुरक्षा और पारदर्शिता पर कड़े नियमों का समर्थन करते हैं।

segments.src: Energy is part of the story too.
segments.tr: ऊर्जा भी इस कहानी का हिस्सा है।

segments.src: Data centers use a lot of electricity, and countries are competing to secure the power, chips and talent needed to lead in the technology.
segments.tr: डेटा सेंटर बहुत अधिक बिजली का उपयोग करते हैं, और देश प्रौद्योगिकी में आगे रहने के लिए आवश्यक बिजली, चिप्स और प्रतिभा को सुरक्षित करने के लिए प्रतिस्पर्धा कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: Agreement on common standards would be a notable result, though differences between the major powers make a broad binding pact unlikely.
segments.tr: सामान्य मानकों पर सहमति एक उल्लेखनीय परिणाम होगा, हालांकि प्रमुख शक्तियों के बीच मतभेद एक व्यापक बाध्यकारी समझौते की संभावना को कम करते हैं।

segments.src: ## Where the major economies disagree
segments.tr: ## प्रमुख अर्थव्यवस्थाएं कहां असहमत हैं

segments.src: - **U.S. and China:** Trade, technology controls and market access remain the biggest points of friction.
segments.tr: - **U.S. और चीन:** व्यापार, प्रौद्योगिकी नियंत्रण और बाजार पहुंच घर्षण के सबसे बड़े बिंदु बने हुए हैं।

segments.src: - **U.S. and Europe:** Disagreements over tariffs, digital regulation and climate policy could surface.
segments.tr: - **U.S. और यूरोप:** शुल्क, डिजिटल विनियमन और जलवायु नीति को लेकर असहमति सतह पर आ सकती है।

segments.src: - **Advanced and emerging economies:** Countries in the Global South want a bigger voice on debt relief, climate finance and the rules of global trade.
segments.tr: - **उन्नत और उभरती अर्थव्यवस्थाएं:** ग्लोबल साउथ के देश ऋण राहत, जलवायु वित्तपोषण और वैश्विक व्यापार के नियमों पर अधिक आवाज चाहते हैं।

segments.src: - **Geopolitics:** Ongoing conflicts and sanctions can shape the tone of the meetings and make a joint final statement harder to reach.
segments.tr: - **भू-राजनीति:** जारी संघर्ष और प्रतिबंध बैठकों के स्वर को आकार दे सकते हैं और एक संयुक्त अंतिम बयान तक पहुंचना कठिन बना सकते हैं।

segments.src: In past years, disagreement has sometimes meant that leaders could not agree on a full joint communiqué.
segments.tr: पिछले वर्षों में, असहमति का कभी-कभी अर्थ यह हुआ है कि नेता एक पूर्ण संयुक्त विज्ञप्ति पर सहमत नहीं हो सके।

segments.src: The host may instead issue a chair's summary or narrower statements on topics where consensus exists.
segments.tr: मेजबान इसके बजाय अध्यक्ष का सारांश या उन विषयों पर संकीर्ण बयान जारी कर सकता है जहां सर्वसम्मति मौजूद है।

segments.src: ## What it could mean for markets
segments.tr: ## बाजारों के लिए इसका क्या अर्थ हो सकता है

segments.src: Investors usually watch the G20 for signals, not for surprises.
segments.tr: निवेशक आमतौर पर आश्चर्य के बजाय संकेतों के लिए G20 को देखते हैं।

segments.src: Clear signs of easing trade tensions could support stocks and reduce currency swings.
segments.tr: व्यापारिक तनाव कम होने के स्पष्ट संकेत शेयरों का समर्थन कर सकते हैं और मुद्रा में उतार-चढ़ाव को कम कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: A breakdown in talks, or new tariff threats, could do the opposite.
segments.tr: वार्ता में गतिरोध, या नए शुल्क की धमकियाँ, इसके विपरीत काम कर सकती हैं।

segments.src: Bond markets may pay attention to any language about debt and fiscal discipline.
segments.tr: बॉन्ड बाजार ऋण और वित्तीय अनुशासन के बारे में किसी भी भाषा पर ध्यान दे सकते हैं।

segments.src: Technology and energy companies will watch the AI discussions for hints about future rules and investment.
segments.tr: प्रौद्योगिकी और ऊर्जा कंपनियां भविष्य के नियमों और निवेश के बारे में संकेतों के लिए AI चर्चाओं पर नजर रखेंगी।

segments.src: Market moves around such events are often short-lived.
segments.tr: ऐसी घटनाओं के आसपास बाजार की हलचल अक्सर अल्पकालिक होती है।

segments.src: Economic data, central bank decisions and corporate earnings usually matter more over time.
segments.tr: आर्थिक आंकड़े, केंद्रीय बैंक के फैसले और कॉर्पोरेट कमाई आमतौर पर समय के साथ अधिक मायने रखती है।

segments.src: ## What it could mean for everyday prices
segments.tr: ## रोजमर्रा की कीमतों के लिए इसका क्या अर्थ हो सकता है

segments.src: For households, the effect is indirect and slow.
segments.tr: परिवारों के लिए, इसका प्रभाव अप्रत्यक्ष और धीमा होता है।

segments.src: A few ways the summit's topics can reach your budget:
segments.tr: कुछ तरीके जिनसे शिखर सम्मेलन के विषय आपके बजट तक पहुंच सकते हैं:

segments.src: - **Tariffs** can raise the prices of imported goods such as electronics, clothing, cars and some groceries. A deal that lowers them could eventually ease costs, while escalation could add to them.
segments.tr: - **शुल्क (टैरिफ)** इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स, कपड़े, कार और कुछ किराने के सामान जैसी आयातित वस्तुओं की कीमतें बढ़ा सकते हैं। एक सौदा जो उन्हें कम करता है, अंततः लागत कम कर सकता है, जबकि तनाव बढ़ने से लागत बढ़ सकती है।

segments.src: - **Interest rates** are affected by government borrowing and inflation expectations, which influence mortgage, auto loan and credit card rates.
segments.tr: - **ब्याज दरें** सरकारी उधार और मुद्रास्फीति की उम्मीदों से प्रभावित होती हैं, जो बंधक (मॉर्टगेज), ऑटो ऋण और क्रेडिट कार्ड दरों को प्रभावित करती हैं।

segments.src: - **Supply chain stability** affects how reliably products reach store shelves and how much they cost.
segments.tr: - **आपूर्ति श्रृंखला की स्थिरता** इस बात को प्रभावित करती है कि उत्पाद स्टोर अलमारियों तक कितनी विश्वसनीयता से पहुंचते हैं और उनकी लागत कितनी है।

segments.src: - **AI and jobs** may reshape hiring, wages and the services people use, although the timeline is uncertain.
segments.tr: - **AI और नौकरियां** काम पर रखने, वेतन और लोगों द्वारा उपयोग की जाने वाली सेवाओं को नया रूप दे सकती हैं, हालांकि समय सीमा अनिश्चित है।

segments.src: None of these effects happens overnight, and a summit statement alone does not change prices.
segments.tr: इनमें से कोई भी प्रभाव रातों-रात नहीं होता है, और केवल शिखर सम्मेलन का एक बयान कीमतें नहीं बदलता है।

segments.src: What matters is whether leaders follow words with policy.
segments.tr: मायने यह रखता है कि क्या नेता शब्दों के बाद नीति पर अमल करते हैं।

segments.src: ## What to look for
segments.tr: ## क्या ध्यान रखना है

segments.src: When the summit ends, a few questions will help you judge how it went:
segments.tr: शिखर सम्मेलन समाप्त होने पर, कुछ प्रश्न आपको यह आंकने में मदद करेंगे कि यह कैसा रहा:

segments.src: 1. Did leaders agree on a joint declaration, or only on partial statements?
segments.tr: 1. क्या नेता एक संयुक्त घोषणा पर सहमत हुए, या केवल आंशिक बयानों पर?

segments.src: 2. Were there concrete commitments on trade, such as timelines or specific rule changes?
segments.tr: 2. क्या व्यापार पर ठोस प्रतिबद्धताएं थीं, जैसे कि समय सीमा या विशिष्ट नियम परिवर्तन?

segments.src: 3. Did any progress on debt relief come with real funding or procedures?
segments.tr: 3. क्या ऋण राहत पर कोई प्रगति वास्तविक वित्तपोषण या प्रक्रियाओं के साथ हुई?

segments.src: 4. Was there agreement on shared principles for AI?
segments.tr: 4. क्या AI के लिए साझा सिद्धांतों पर सहमति बनी?

segments.src: 5. Did leaders hold bilateral meetings that signal a thaw, or a deeper split?
segments.tr: 5. क्या नेताओं ने द्विपक्षीय बैठकें आयोजित कीं जो तनाव कम होने, या गहरे विभाजन का संकेत देती हैं?

segments.src: The G20 rarely delivers dramatic breakthroughs.
segments.tr: G20 शायद ही कभी नाटकीय सफलताएं प्रदान करता है।

segments.src: Its influence usually shows up in the months afterward, as governments act on what they agreed to, or fail to.
segments.tr: इसका प्रभाव आमतौर पर बाद के महीनों में दिखता है, जब सरकारें उस पर कार्रवाई करती हैं जिस पर वे सहमत हुई थीं, या विफल रहती हैं।

segments.src: This year's meeting on American soil will test whether the world's largest economies can find common ground in a period of rising friction.
segments.tr: अमेरिकी धरती पर इस साल की बैठक यह परीक्षण करेगी कि क्या दुनिया की सबसे बड़ी अर्थव्यवस्थाएं बढ़ते तनाव के दौर में समान आधार तलाश सकती हैं।

segments.tr: *यह लेख केवल सामान्य जानकारी के उद्देश्यों के लिए है और वित्तीय या निवेश सलाह नहीं है।*

es.title: El G20 llega a Estados Unidos: qué vigilar sobre comercio, deuda e inteligencia artificial

segments.src: The United States is set to host this year's Group of 20 leaders' summit in Florida next month.
segments.tr: Estados Unidos se prepara para albergar este año la cumbre de líderes del Grupo de los 20 en Florida el próximo mes.

segments.src: The meeting brings together the world's largest economies at a tense moment for the global economy.
segments.tr: La reunión reúne a las economías más grandes del mundo en un momento tenso para la economía global.

segments.src: Tariffs, heavy government debt and the fast spread of artificial intelligence are all competing for attention.
segments.tr: Los aranceles, la fuerte deuda gubernamental y la rápida propagación de la inteligencia artificial compiten por la atención.

segments.src: This guide covers what is on the table, where the major economies disagree, and what the talks could mean for markets and household budgets.
segments.tr: Esta guía cubre qué está sobre la mesa, dónde discrepan las principales economías y qué podrían significar las conversaciones para los mercados y los presupuestos familiares.

segments.src: *Note: Summit schedules, guest lists and agenda items can change.
segments.tr: *Nota: Los horarios de las cumbres, las listas de invitados y los puntos de la agenda pueden cambiar.

segments.src: Check official government announcements for the latest details.*
segments.tr: Consulte los anuncios oficiales del gobierno para obtener los detalles más recientes.*

segments.src: ## Why this summit matters
segments.tr: ## Por qué importa esta cumbre

segments.src: The G20 includes the United States, China, the European Union, Japan, India, Germany, the United Kingdom, Brazil and other major economies.
segments.tr: El G20 incluye a Estados Unidos, China, la Unión Europea, Japón, India, Alemania, el Reino Unido, Brasil y otras grandes economías.

segments.src: Together they account for the large majority of global economic output and trade.
segments.tr: Juntos representan la gran mayoría de la producción y el comercio económico mundial.

segments.src: The group has no power to pass binding laws.
segments.tr: El grupo no tiene poder para aprobar leyes vinculantes.

segments.src: Its value comes from putting leaders in one room, setting shared priorities and nudging national policies in the same direction.
segments.tr: Su valor proviene de reunir a los líderes en una sola sala, establecer prioridades compartidas e impulsar las políticas nacionales en la misma dirección.

segments.src: Hosting the summit gives Washington a chance to shape the agenda.
segments.tr: Ser anfitrión de la cumbre le da a Washington la oportunidad de dar forma a la agenda.

segments.src: It also puts the host under close scrutiny, since many partners have criticized recent U.S.
segments.tr: También pone al anfitrión bajo un escrutinio cercano, ya que muchos socios han criticado la reciente política comercial de EE.

segments.src: trade policy.
segments.tr: UU.

segments.src: ## Trade: the central tension
segments.tr: ## Comercio: la tensión central

segments.src: Trade is likely to dominate the conversation.
segments.tr: Es probable que el comercio domine la conversación.

segments.src: Over the past few years, higher tariffs and shifting trade rules have changed how goods move around the world.
segments.tr: En los últimos años, los aranceles más altos y las cambiantes reglas comerciales han cambiado la forma en que los bienes se mueven por todo el mundo.

segments.src: Several themes are likely to come up:
segments.tr: Es probable que surjan varios temas:

segments.src: - **Tariffs and retaliation.** Governments are weighing how far to go with import taxes and how to respond when others raise theirs.
segments.tr: - **Aranceles y represalias.** Los gobiernos están sopesando hasta dónde llegar con los impuestos a la importación y cómo responder cuando otros aumentan los suyos.

segments.src: - **Supply chains.** Many companies are moving production closer to home or to friendlier countries, which can raise costs in the short run.
segments.tr: - **Cadenas de suministro.** Muchas empresas están trasladando la producción más cerca de casa o a países más amigables, lo que puede aumentar los costos a corto plazo.

segments.src: - **The role of the World Trade Organization.** Leaders disagree on whether its rules still work and how they should be updated.
segments.tr: - **El papel de la Organización Mundial del Comercio.** Los líderes discrepan sobre si sus reglas aún funcionan y cómo deben actualizarse.

segments.src: - **Critical minerals and technology.** Access to rare earths, advanced chips and batteries has become a matter of national security as well as commerce.
segments.tr: - **Minerales críticos y tecnología.** El acceso a tierras raras, chips avanzados y baterías se ha convertido en un asunto de seguridad nacional y de comercio.

segments.src: Expect plenty of talks on the sidelines between individual leaders.
segments.tr: Espere muchas conversaciones al margen entre líderes individuales.

segments.src: Those side meetings sometimes produce more concrete results than the group communiqué does.
segments.tr: Esas reuniones paralelas a veces producen resultados más concretos que el comunicado del grupo.

segments.src: ## Debt: a slow-burning pressure
segments.tr: ## Deuda: una presión de combustión lenta

segments.src: Government borrowing is another major topic.
segments.tr: El endeudamiento gubernamental es otro tema importante.

segments.src: Many advanced economies carry debt levels well above where they stood before the pandemic.
segments.tr: Muchas economías avanzadas tienen niveles de deuda muy por encima de los que tenían antes de la pandemia.

segments.src: Higher interest rates make that debt more expensive to service.
segments.tr: Las tasas de interés más altas encarecen el servicio de esa deuda.

segments.src: Poorer countries face an even sharper problem, since some spend more on interest payments than on health or education.
segments.tr: Los países más pobres enfrentan un problema aún más agudo, ya que algunos gastan más en pagos de intereses que en salud o educación.

segments.src: Possible discussion points include:
segments.tr: Los posibles puntos de discusión incluyen:

segments.src: 1. How to restructure debt for low-income countries faster and more fairly.
segments.tr: 1. Cómo reestructurar la deuda para los países de bajos ingresos de manera más rápida y justa.

segments.src: 2. The role of large lenders, including China, other governments and private creditors.
segments.tr: 2. El papel de los grandes prestamistas, incluidos China, otros gobiernos y acreedores privados.

segments.src: 3. Whether wealthy countries can keep their own borrowing on a sustainable path.
segments.tr: 3. Si los países ricos pueden mantener su propio endeudamiento en un camino sostenible.

segments.src: 4. Support for development banks and the International Monetary Fund.
segments.tr: 4. Apoyo a los bancos de desarrollo y al Fondo Monetario Internacional.

segments.src: Progress here tends to be gradual.
segments.tr: El progreso aquí tiende a ser gradual.

segments.src: A realistic outcome is a statement of principles or a small step on coordination, not a sweeping deal.
segments.tr: Un resultado realista es una declaración de principios o un pequeño paso en la coordinación, no un acuerdo radical.

segments.src: ## Artificial intelligence: new rules, new rivalries
segments.tr: ## Inteligencia artificial: nuevas reglas, nuevas rivalidades

segments.src: AI has moved from a niche topic to a core economic issue.
segments.tr: La IA ha pasado de ser un tema de nicho a un problema económico central.

segments.src: Leaders are expected to discuss how to encourage investment and innovation while managing risks such as job disruption, misinformation and security threats.
segments.tr: Se espera que los líderes discutan cómo fomentar la inversión y la innovación mientras gestionan riesgos como la interrupción laboral, la desinformación y las amenazas a la seguridad.

segments.src: Governments take different approaches.
segments.tr: Los gobiernos adoptan diferentes enfoques.

segments.src: Some prefer light regulation to speed up growth, while others favor firmer rules on safety and transparency.
segments.tr: Algunos prefieren una regulación ligera para acelerar el crecimiento, mientras que otros favorecen reglas más firmes sobre seguridad y transparencia.

segments.src: Energy is part of the story too.
segments.tr: La energía también es parte de la historia.

segments.src: Data centers use a lot of electricity, and countries are competing to secure the power, chips and talent needed to lead in the technology.
segments.tr: Los centros de datos usan mucha electricidad y los países compiten para asegurar la energía, los chips y el talento necesarios para liderar en la tecnología.

segments.src: Agreement on common standards would be a notable result, though differences between the major powers make a broad binding pact unlikely.
segments.tr: Un acuerdo sobre estándares comunes sería un resultado notable, aunque las diferencias entre las grandes potencias hacen improbable un pacto vinculante amplio.

segments.src: ## Where the major economies disagree
segments.tr: ## Dónde discrepan las principales economías

segments.src: - **U.S. and China:** Trade, technology controls and market access remain the biggest points of friction.
segments.tr: - **EE. UU. y China:** El comercio, los controles tecnológicos y el acceso al mercado siguen siendo los mayores puntos de fricción.

segments.src: - **U.S. and Europe:** Disagreements over tariffs, digital regulation and climate policy could surface.
segments.tr: - **EE. UU. y Europa:** Podrían surgir desacuerdos sobre aranceles, regulación digital y política climática.

segments.src: - **Advanced and emerging economies:** Countries in the Global South want a bigger voice on debt relief, climate finance and the rules of global trade.
segments.tr: - **Economías avanzadas y emergentes:** Los países del Sur Global quieren una mayor voz en el alivio de la deuda, la financiación climática y las reglas del comercio mundial.

segments.src: - **Geopolitics:** Ongoing conflicts and sanctions can shape the tone of the meetings and make a joint final statement harder to reach.
segments.tr: - **Geopolítica:** Los conflictos y sanciones en curso pueden moldear el tono de las reuniones y dificultar alcanzar una declaración conjunta final.

segments.src: In past years, disagreement has sometimes meant that leaders could not agree on a full joint communiqué.
segments.tr: En años anteriores, el desacuerdo a veces ha significado que los líderes no pudieron ponerse de acuerdo sobre un comunicado conjunto completo.

segments.src: The host may instead issue a chair's summary or narrower statements on topics where consensus exists.
segments.tr: En su lugar, el anfitrión puede emitir un resumen del presidente o declaraciones más limitadas sobre temas donde existe consenso.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for markets
segments.tr: ## Qué podría significar para los mercados

segments.src: Investors usually watch the G20 for signals, not for surprises.
segments.tr: Los inversores suelen observar al G20 en busca de señales, no de sorpresas.

segments.src: Clear signs of easing trade tensions could support stocks and reduce currency swings.
segments.tr: Las señales claras de una disminución de las tensiones comerciales podrían respaldar las acciones y reducir las fluctuaciones monetarias.

segments.src: A breakdown in talks, or new tariff threats, could do the opposite.
segments.tr: Una ruptura en las conversaciones, o nuevas amenazas arancelarias, podría hacer lo contrario.

segments.src: Bond markets may pay attention to any language about debt and fiscal discipline.
segments.tr: Los mercados de bonos pueden prestar atención a cualquier lenguaje sobre deuda y disciplina fiscal.

segments.src: Technology and energy companies will watch the AI discussions for hints about future rules and investment.
segments.tr: Las empresas de tecnología y energía observarán las discusiones sobre la IA en busca de indicios sobre futuras reglas e inversiones.

segments.src: Market moves around such events are often short-lived.
segments.tr: Los movimientos del mercado en torno a tales eventos suelen ser de corta duración.

segments.src: Economic data, central bank decisions and corporate earnings usually matter more over time.
segments.tr: Los datos económicos, las decisiones de los bancos centrales y las ganancias corporativas suelen importar más con el tiempo.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for everyday prices
segments.tr: ## Qué podría significar para los precios cotidianos

segments.src: For households, the effect is indirect and slow.
segments.tr: Para los hogares, el efecto es indirecto y lento.

segments.src: A few ways the summit's topics can reach your budget:
segments.tr: Algunas formas en que los temas de la cumbre pueden llegar a su presupuesto:

segments.src: - **Tariffs** can raise the prices of imported goods such as electronics, clothing, cars and some groceries. A deal that lowers them could eventually ease costs, while escalation could add to them.
segments.tr: - **Los aranceles** pueden elevar los precios de los bienes importados como electrónica, ropa, automóviles y algunos comestibles. Un acuerdo que los reduzca podría eventualmente aliviar los costos, mientras que una escalada podría aumentarlos.

segments.src: - **Interest rates** are affected by government borrowing and inflation expectations, which influence mortgage, auto loan and credit card rates.
segments.tr: - **Las tasas de interés** se ven afectadas por el endeudamiento del gobierno y las expectativas de inflación, lo que influye en las tasas hipotecarias, de préstamos para automóviles y de tarjetas de crédito.

segments.src: - **Supply chain stability** affects how reliably products reach store shelves and how much they cost.
segments.tr: - **La estabilidad de la cadena de suministro** afecta la fiabilidad con la que los productos llegan a los estantes de las tiendas y cuánto cuestan.

segments.src: - **AI and jobs** may reshape hiring, wages and the services people use, although the timeline is uncertain.
segments.tr: - **La IA y los empleos** pueden remodelar la contratación, los salarios y los servicios que usan las personas, aunque el cronograma es incierto.

segments.src: None of these effects happens overnight, and a summit statement alone does not change prices.
segments.tr: Ninguno de estos efectos ocurre de la noche a la mañana, y una declaración de la cumbre por sí sola no cambia los precios.

segments.src: What matters is whether leaders follow words with policy.
segments.tr: Lo que importa es si los líderes siguen las palabras con políticas.

segments.src: ## What to look for
segments.tr: ## Qué buscar

segments.src: When the summit ends, a few questions will help you judge how it went:
segments.tr: Cuando termine la cumbre, algunas preguntas le ayudarán a juzgar cómo fue:

segments.src: 1. Did leaders agree on a joint declaration, or only on partial statements?
segments.tr: 1. ¿Acordaron los líderes una declaración conjunta o solo declaraciones parciales?

segments.src: 2. Were there concrete commitments on trade, such as timelines or specific rule changes?
segments.tr: 2. ¿Hubo compromisos concretos sobre el comercio, como cronogramas o cambios de reglas específicos?

segments.src: 3. Did any progress on debt relief come with real funding or procedures?
segments.tr: 3. ¿Vino algún progreso en el alivio de la deuda con fondos o procedimientos reales?

segments.src: 4. Was there agreement on shared principles for AI?
segments.tr: 4. ¿Hubo acuerdo sobre principios compartidos para la IA?

segments.src: 5. Did leaders hold bilateral meetings that signal a thaw, or a deeper split?
segments.tr: 5. ¿Mantuvieron los líderes reuniones bilaterales que señalen un deshielo o una división más profunda?

segments.src: The G20 rarely delivers dramatic breakthroughs.
segments.tr: El G20 rara vez ofrece avances dramáticos.

segments.src: Its influence usually shows up in the months afterward, as governments act on what they agreed to, or fail to.
segments.tr: Su influencia suele manifestarse en los meses posteriores, a medida que los gobiernos actúan sobre lo que acordaron, o no lo hacen.

segments.src: This year's meeting on American soil will test whether the world's largest economies can find common ground in a period of rising friction.
segments.tr: La reunión de este año en suelo estadounidense pondrá a prueba si las economías más grandes del mundo pueden encontrar puntos en común en un período de creciente fricción.

ar.title: مجموعة العشرين تأتي إلى أمريكا: ما الذي يجب مراقبته بشأن التجارة والديون والذكاء الاصطناعي

segments.src: The United States is set to host this year's Group of 20 leaders' summit in Florida next month.
segments.tr: من المقرر أن تستضيف الولايات المتحدة قمة قادة مجموعة العشرين لهذا العام في فلوريدا الشهر المقبل.

segments.src: The meeting brings together the world's largest economies at a tense moment for the global economy.
segments.tr: يجمع الاجتماع أكبر اقتصادات العالم في لحظة متوترة للاقتصاد العالمي.

segments.src: Tariffs, heavy government debt and the fast spread of artificial intelligence are all competing for attention.
segments.tr: تتنافس التعريفات الجمركية، والديون الحكومية الثقيلة، والانتشار السريع للذكاء الاصطناعي على جذب الاهتمام.

segments.src: This guide covers what is on the table, where the major economies disagree, and what the talks could mean for markets and household budgets.
segments.tr: يغطي هذا الدليل ما هو مطروح على الطاولة، وأين تختلف الاقتصادات الكبرى، وما يمكن أن تعنيه المحادثات للأسواق وميزانيات الأسر.

segments.src: *Note: Summit schedules, guest lists and agenda items can change.
segments.tr: *ملاحظة: يمكن أن تتغير جداول القمة وقوائم الضيوف وبنود جدول الأعمال.

segments.src: Check official government announcements for the latest details.*
segments.tr: تحقق من الإعلانات الحكومية الرسمية للحصول على أحدث التفاصيل.*

segments.src: ## Why this summit matters
segments.tr: ## لماذا تهم هذه القمة

segments.src: The G20 includes the United States, China, the European Union, Japan, India, Germany, the United Kingdom, Brazil and other major economies.
segments.tr: تضم مجموعة العشرين الولايات المتحدة، والصين، والاتحاد الأوروبي، واليابان، والهند، وألمانيا، والمملكة المتحدة، والبرازيل، وغيرها من الاقتصادات الكبرى.

segments.src: Together they account for the large majority of global economic output and trade.
segments.tr: وهي تمثل معاً الغالبية العظمى من الناتج الاقتصادي والتجارة العالمية.

segments.src: The group has no power to pass binding laws.
segments.tr: لا تملك المجموعة سلطة تمرير قوانين ملزمة.

segments.src: Its value comes from putting leaders in one room, setting shared priorities and nudging national policies in the same direction.
segments.tr: تكمن قيمتها في جمع القادة في غرفة واحدة، وتحديد الأولويات المشتركة، وتوجيه السياسات الوطنية في نفس الاتجاه.

segments.src: Hosting the summit gives Washington a chance to shape the agenda.
segments.tr: تمنح استضافة القمة واشنطن فرصة لتشكيل جدول الأعمال.

segments.src: It also puts the host under close scrutiny, since many partners have criticized recent U.S.
segments.tr: كما أنها تضع المضيف تحت تدقيق وثيق، حيث انتقد العديد من الشركاء السياسة التجارية الأمريكية

segments.src: trade policy.
segments.tr: الأخيرة.

segments.src: ## Trade: the central tension
segments.tr: ## التجارة: التوتر المركزي

segments.src: Trade is likely to dominate the conversation.
segments.tr: من المرجح أن تهيمن التجارة على المحادثات.

segments.src: Over the past few years, higher tariffs and shifting trade rules have changed how goods move around the world.
segments.tr: على مدى السنوات القليلة الماضية، أدت التعريفات الجمركية الأعلى وقواعد التجارة المتغيرة إلى تغيير كيفية انتقال البضائع حول العالم.

segments.src: Several themes are likely to come up:
segments.tr: من المرجح أن تظهر عدة موضوعات:

segments.src: - **Tariffs and retaliation.** Governments are weighing how far to go with import taxes and how to respond when others raise theirs.
segments.tr: - **التعريفات الجمركية والانتقام.** تدرس الحكومات إلى أي مدى يجب أن تذهب في ضرائب الاستيراد وكيفية الرد عندما يرفع الآخرون ضرائبهم.

segments.src: - **Supply chains.** Many companies are moving production closer to home or to friendlier countries, which can raise costs in the short run.
segments.tr: - **سلاسل التوريد.** تقوم العديد من الشركات بنقل الإنتاج بالقرب من الوطن أو إلى دول أكثر ودية، مما قد يرفع التكاليف على المدى القصير.

segments.src: - **The role of the World Trade Organization.** Leaders disagree on whether its rules still work and how they should be updated.
segments.tr: - **دور منظمة التجارة العالمية.** يختلف القادة حول ما إذا كانت قواعدها لا تزال تعمل وكيف ينبغي تحديثها.

segments.src: - **Critical minerals and technology.** Access to rare earths, advanced chips and batteries has become a matter of national security as well as commerce.
segments.tr: - **المعادن الحيوية والتكنولوجيا.** أصبح الوصول إلى العناصر الأرضية النادرة والرقائق المتقدمة والبطاريات مسألة أمن قومي بالإضافة إلى التجارة.

segments.src: Expect plenty of talks on the sidelines between individual leaders.
segments.tr: توقع الكثير من المحادثات على الهامش بين القادة الأفراد.

segments.src: Those side meetings sometimes produce more concrete results than the group communiqué does.
segments.tr: تنتج تلك الاجتماعات الجانبية أحياناً نتائج ملموسة أكثر مما ينتجه بيان المجموعة.

segments.src: ## Debt: a slow-burning pressure
segments.tr: ## الديون: ضغط بطيء الاحتراق

segments.src: Government borrowing is another major topic.
segments.tr: الاقتراض الحكومي هو موضوع رئيسي آخر.

segments.src: Many advanced economies carry debt levels well above where they stood before the pandemic.
segments.tr: تحمل العديد من الاقتصادات المتقدمة مستويات ديون أعلى بكثير مما كانت عليه قبل الجائحة.

segments.src: Higher interest rates make that debt more expensive to service.
segments.tr: تجعل أسعار الفائدة المرتفعة خدمة تلك الديون أكثر تكلفة.

segments.src: Poorer countries face an even sharper problem, since some spend more on interest payments than on health or education.
segments.tr: تواجه الدول الأكثر فقراً مشكلة أكثر حدة، حيث تنفق بعضها على مدفوعات الفائدة أكثر مما تنفقه على الصحة أو التعليم.

segments.src: Possible discussion points include:
segments.tr: تشمل نقاط النقاش المحتملة:

segments.src: 1. How to restructure debt for low-income countries faster and more fairly.
segments.tr: 1. كيفية إعادة هيكلة ديون الدول منخفضة الدخل بشكل أسرع وأكثر عدالة.

segments.src: 2. The role of large lenders, including China, other governments and private creditors.
segments.tr: 2. دور المقرضين الكبار، بما في ذلك الصين والحكومات الأخرى والدائنين من القطاع الخاص.

segments.src: 3. Whether wealthy countries can keep their own borrowing on a sustainable path.
segments.tr: 3. ما إذا كانت الدول الغنية قادرة على إبقاء اقتراضها الخاص على مسار مستدام.

segments.src: 4. Support for development banks and the International Monetary Fund.
segments.tr: 4. دعم بنوك التنمية وصندوق النقد الدولي.

segments.src: Progress here tends to be gradual.
segments.tr: يميل التقدم هنا إلى أن يكون تدريجياً.

segments.src: A realistic outcome is a statement of principles or a small step on coordination, not a sweeping deal.
segments.tr: النتيجة الواقعية هي بيان مبادئ أو خطوة صغيرة نحو التنسيق، وليس صفقة شاملة.

segments.tr: ## الذكاء الاصطناعي: قواعد جديدة، منافسات جديدة

fr.title: Le G20 arrive en Amérique : ce qu'il faut surveiller concernant le commerce, la dette et l'IA

segments.src: The United States is set to host this year's Group of 20 leaders' summit in Florida next month.
segments.tr: Les États-Unis s'apprêtent à accueillir le sommet des dirigeants du G20 cette année en Floride le mois prochain.

segments.src: The meeting brings together the world's largest economies at a tense moment for the global economy.
segments.tr: La réunion rassemble les plus grandes économies mondiales à un moment tendu pour l'économie mondiale.

segments.src: Tariffs, heavy government debt and the fast spread of artificial intelligence are all competing for attention.
segments.tr: Les droits de douane, la lourde dette publique et la propagation rapide de l'intelligence artificielle se disputent l'attention.

segments.src: This guide covers what is on the table, where the major economies disagree, and what the talks could mean for markets and household budgets.
segments.tr: Ce guide couvre les sujets à l'ordre du jour, les points de désaccord entre les grandes économies, et ce que les discussions pourraient signifier pour les marchés et les budgets des ménages.

segments.src: *Note: Summit schedules, guest lists and agenda items can change.
segments.tr: *Remarque : Les calendriers des sommets, les listes d'invités et les points à l'ordre du jour peuvent changer.

segments.src: Check official government announcements for the latest details.*
segments.tr: Consultez les annonces officielles du gouvernement pour obtenir les derniers détails.*

segments.src: ## Why this summit matters
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi ce sommet est important

segments.src: The G20 includes the United States, China, the European Union, Japan, India, Germany, the United Kingdom, Brazil and other major economies.
segments.tr: Le G20 comprend les États-Unis, la Chine, l'Union européenne, le Japon, l'Inde, l'Allemagne, le Royaume-Uni, le Brésil et d'autres économies majeures.

segments.src: Together they account for the large majority of global economic output and trade.
segments.tr: Ensemble, ils représentent la grande majorité de la production économique et du commerce mondiaux.

segments.src: The group has no power to pass binding laws.
segments.tr: Le groupe n'a pas le pouvoir d'adopter des lois contraignantes.

segments.src: Its value comes from putting leaders in one room, setting shared priorities and nudging national policies in the same direction.
segments.tr: Sa valeur réside dans le fait de réunir les dirigeants dans une même pièce, de définir des priorités communes et d'orienter les politiques nationales dans la même direction.

segments.src: Hosting the summit gives Washington a chance to shape the agenda.
segments.tr: Accueillir le sommet donne à Washington l'occasion de façonner l'ordre du jour.

segments.src: It also puts the host under close scrutiny, since many partners have criticized recent U.S.
segments.tr: Cela place également l'hôte sous une surveillance étroite, car de nombreux partenaires ont critiqué la récente politique commerciale des États-Unis.

segments.src: trade policy.
## Trade: the central tension
segments.tr: ## Commerce : la tension centrale

segments.src: Trade is likely to dominate the conversation.
segments.tr: Le commerce devrait dominer la conversation.

segments.src: Over the past few years, higher tariffs and shifting trade rules have changed how goods move around the world.
segments.tr: Au cours des dernières années, l'augmentation des droits de douane et l'évolution des règles commerciales ont modifié la façon dont les marchandises circulent dans le monde.

segments.src: Several themes are likely to come up:
segments.tr: Plusieurs thèmes devraient être abordés :

segments.src: - **Tariffs and retaliation.** Governments are weighing how far to go with import taxes and how to respond when others raise theirs.
segments.tr: - **Droits de douane et représailles.** Les gouvernements évaluent jusqu'où aller avec les taxes à l'importation et comment réagir lorsque d'autres augmentent les leurs.

segments.src: - **Supply chains.** Many companies are moving production closer to home or to friendlier countries, which can raise costs in the short run.
segments.tr: - **Chaînes d'approvisionnement.** De nombreuses entreprises déplacent leur production plus près de chez elles ou vers des pays plus amicaux, ce qui peut augmenter les coûts à court terme.

segments.src: - **The role of the World Trade Organization.** Leaders disagree on whether its rules still work and how they should be updated.
segments.tr: - **Le rôle de l'Organisation mondiale du commerce.** Les dirigeants ne sont pas d'accord sur la question de savoir si ses règles fonctionnent toujours et comment elles devraient être mises à jour.

segments.src: - **Critical minerals and technology.** Access to rare earths, advanced chips and batteries has become a matter of national security as well as commerce.
segments.tr: - **Minéraux critiques et technologie.** L'accès aux terres rares, aux puces avancées et aux batteries est devenu une question de sécurité nationale autant que de commerce.

segments.src: Expect plenty of talks on the sidelines between individual leaders.
segments.tr: Attendez-vous à de nombreuses discussions en marge entre les dirigeants individuels.

segments.src: Those side meetings sometimes produce more concrete results than the group communiqué does.
segments.tr: Ces réunions parallèles produisent parfois des résultats plus concrets que le communiqué du groupe.

segments.src: ## Debt: a slow-burning pressure
segments.tr: ## Dette : une pression à combustion lente

segments.src: Government borrowing is another major topic.
segments.tr: L'emprunt public est un autre sujet majeur.

segments.src: Many advanced economies carry debt levels well above where they stood before the pandemic.
segments.tr: De nombreuses économies avancées ont des niveaux d'endettement bien supérieurs à ceux d'avant la pandémie.

segments.src: Higher interest rates make that debt more expensive to service.
segments.tr: La hausse des taux d'intérêt rend le service de cette dette plus coûteux.

segments.src: Poorer countries face an even sharper problem, since some spend more on interest payments than on health or education.
segments.tr: Les pays les plus pauvres sont confrontés à un problème encore plus aigu, car certains consacrent plus d'argent au paiement des intérêts qu'à la santé ou à l'éducation.

segments.src: Possible discussion points include:
segments.tr: Les points de discussion possibles incluent :

segments.src: 1. How to restructure debt for low-income countries faster and more fairly.
segments.tr: 1. Comment restructurer la dette des pays à faible revenu plus rapidement et plus équitablement.

segments.src: 2. The role of large lenders, including China, other governments and private creditors.
segments.tr: 2. Le rôle des grands prêteurs, y compris la Chine, d'autres gouvernements et les créanciers privés.

segments.src: 3. Whether wealthy countries can keep their own borrowing on a sustainable path.
segments.tr: 3. Si les pays riches peuvent maintenir leurs propres emprunts sur une trajectoire durable.

segments.src: 4. Support for development banks and the International Monetary Fund.
segments.tr: 4. Le soutien aux banques de développement et au Fonds monétaire international.

segments.src: Progress here tends to be gradual.
segments.tr: Les progrès dans ce domaine ont tendance à être progressifs.

segments.src: A realistic outcome is a statement of principles or a small step on coordination, not a sweeping deal.
segments.tr: Un résultat réaliste est une déclaration de principes ou une petite étape en matière de coordination, et non un accord global.

segments.src: ## Artificial intelligence: new rules, new rivalries
segments.tr: ## Intelligence artificielle : nouvelles règles, nouvelles rivalités

segments.src: AI has moved from a niche topic to a core economic issue.
segments.tr: L'IA est passée d'un sujet de niche à un enjeu économique central.

segments.src: Leaders are expected to discuss how to encourage investment and innovation while managing risks such as job disruption, misinformation and security threats.
segments.tr: Les dirigeants devraient discuter de la manière d'encourager l'investissement et l'innovation tout en gérant les risques tels que les perturbations de l'emploi, la désinformation et les menaces à la sécurité.

segments.src: Governments take different approaches.
segments.tr: Les gouvernements adoptent des approches différentes.

segments.src: Some prefer light regulation to speed up growth, while others favor firmer rules on safety and transparency.
segments.tr: Certains préfèrent une réglementation légère pour accélérer la croissance, tandis que d'autres privilégient des règles plus strictes en matière de sécurité et de transparence.

segments.src: Energy is part of the story too.
segments.tr: L'énergie fait également partie de l'histoire.

segments.src: Data centers use a lot of electricity, and countries are competing to secure the power, chips and talent needed to lead in the technology.
segments.tr: Les centres de données consomment beaucoup d'électricité, et les pays sont en concurrence pour sécuriser l'énergie, les puces et les talents nécessaires pour mener la course technologique.

segments.src: Agreement on common standards would be a notable result, though differences between the major powers make a broad binding pact unlikely.
segments.tr: Un accord sur des normes communes serait un résultat notable, bien que les différences entre les grandes puissances rendent peu probable un pacte contraignant large.

segments.src: ## Where the major economies disagree
segments.tr: ## Où les grandes économies sont en désaccord

segments.src: - **U.S. and China:** Trade, technology controls and market access remain the biggest points of friction.
segments.tr: - **États-Unis et Chine :** Le commerce, les contrôles technologiques et l'accès au marché restent les plus grands points de friction.

segments.src: - **U.S. and Europe:** Disagreements over tariffs, digital regulation and climate policy could surface.
segments.tr: - **États-Unis et Europe :** Des désaccords sur les droits de douane, la réglementation numérique et la politique climatique pourraient faire surface.

segments.src: - **Advanced and emerging economies:** Countries in the Global South want a bigger voice on debt relief, climate finance and the rules of global trade.
segments.tr: - **Économies avancées et émergentes :** Les pays du Sud global veulent avoir davantage leur mot à dire sur l'allégement de la dette, le financement climatique et les règles du commerce mondial.

segments.src: - **Geopolitics:** Ongoing conflicts and sanctions can shape the tone of the meetings and make a joint final statement harder to reach.
segments.tr: - **Géopolitique :** Les conflits et sanctions en cours peuvent façonner le ton des réunions et rendre plus difficile l'obtention d'une déclaration finale commune.

segments.src: In past years, disagreement has sometimes meant that leaders could not agree on a full joint communiqué.
segments.tr: Au cours des années passées, les désaccords ont parfois signifié que les dirigeants ne pouvaient pas s'entendre sur un communiqué commun complet.

segments.src: The host may instead issue a chair's summary or narrower statements on topics where consensus exists.
segments.tr: L'hôte peut plutôt publier un résumé de la présidence ou des déclarations plus limitées sur des sujets où il existe un consensus.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for markets
segments.tr: ## Ce que cela pourrait signifier pour les marchés

segments.src: Investors usually watch the G20 for signals, not for surprises.
segments.tr: Les investisseurs surveillent généralement le G20 pour obtenir des signaux, pas pour des surprises.

segments.src: Clear signs of easing trade tensions could support stocks and reduce currency swings.
segments.tr: Des signes clairs d'apaisement des tensions commerciales pourraient soutenir les actions et réduire les fluctuations monétaires.

segments.src: A breakdown in talks, or new tariff threats, could do the opposite.
segments.tr: Une rupture dans les pourparlers, ou de nouvelles menaces de droits de douane, pourraient avoir l'effet inverse.

segments.src: Bond markets may pay attention to any language about debt and fiscal discipline.
segments.tr: Les marchés obligataires pourraient prêter attention à tout langage concernant la dette et la discipline budgétaire.

segments.src: Technology and energy companies will watch the AI discussions for hints about future rules and investment.
segments.tr: Les entreprises de technologie et d'énergie surveilleront les discussions sur l'IA pour obtenir des indices sur les futures règles et investissements.

segments.src: Market moves around such events are often short-lived.
segments.tr: Les mouvements de marché autour de tels événements sont souvent de courte durée.

segments.src: Economic data, central bank decisions and corporate earnings usually matter more over time.
segments.tr: Les données économiques, les décisions des banques centrales et les résultats des entreprises comptent généralement davantage au fil du temps.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for everyday prices
segments.tr: ## Ce que cela pourrait signifier pour les prix quotidiens

segments.src: For households, the effect is indirect and slow.
segments.tr: Pour les ménages, l'effet est indirect et lent.

segments.src: A few ways the summit's topics can reach your budget:
segments.tr: Quelques façons dont les sujets du sommet peuvent atteindre votre budget :

segments.src: - **Tariffs** can raise the prices of imported goods such as electronics, clothing, cars and some groceries. A deal that lowers them could eventually ease costs, while escalation could add to them.
segments.tr: - **Les droits de douane** peuvent augmenter les prix des produits importés tels que l'électronique, les vêtements, les voitures et certains produits d'épicerie. Un accord qui les réduit pourrait éventuellement alléger les coûts, tandis qu'une escalade pourrait les alourdir.

segments.src: - **Interest rates** are affected by government borrowing and inflation expectations, which influence mortgage, auto loan and credit card rates.
segments.tr: - **Les taux d'intérêt** sont affectés par l'emprunt public et les anticipations d'inflation, qui influencent les taux des prêts hypothécaires, des prêts automobiles et des cartes de crédit.

segments.src: - **Supply chain stability** affects how reliably products reach store shelves and how much they cost.
segments.tr: - **La stabilité de la chaîne d'approvisionnement** affecte la fiabilité avec laquelle les produits atteignent les rayons des magasins et leur coût.

segments.src: - **AI and jobs** may reshape hiring, wages and the services people use, although the timeline is uncertain.
segments.tr: - **L'IA et les emplois** peuvent remodeler l'embauche, les salaires et les services que les gens utilisent, bien que le calendrier soit incertain.

segments.src: None of these effects happens overnight, and a summit statement alone does not change prices.
segments.tr: Aucun de ces effets ne se produit du jour au lendemain, et une déclaration de sommet ne change pas les prix à elle seule.

segments.src: What matters is whether leaders follow words with policy.
segments.tr: Ce qui compte, c'est de savoir si les dirigeants font suivre leurs paroles d'actes politiques.

segments.src: ## What to look for
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'il faut surveiller

segments.src: When the summit ends, a few questions will help you judge how it went:
segments.tr: Lorsque le sommet se termine, quelques questions vous aideront à juger comment il s'est déroulé :

segments.src: 1. Did leaders agree on a joint declaration, or only on partial statements?
segments.tr: 1. Les dirigeants se sont-ils mis d'accord sur une déclaration commune, ou seulement sur des déclarations partielles ?

segments.src: 2. Were there concrete commitments on trade, such as timelines or specific rule changes?
segments.tr: 2. Y a-t-il eu des engagements concrets sur le commerce, tels que des calendriers ou des changements de règles spécifiques ?

segments.src: 3. Did any progress on debt relief come with real funding or procedures?
segments.tr: 3. Les progrès sur l'allégement de la dette ont-ils été accompagnés de financements ou de procédures réels ?

segments.src: 4. Was there agreement on shared principles for AI?
segments.tr: 4. Y a-t-il eu un accord sur des principes partagés pour l'IA ?

segments.src: 5. Did leaders hold bilateral meetings that signal a thaw, or a deeper split?
segments.tr: 5. Les dirigeants ont-ils tenu des réunions bilatérales signalant un dégel, ou une scission plus profonde ?

segments.src: The G20 rarely delivers dramatic breakthroughs.
segments.tr: Le G20 produit rarement des percées spectaculaires.

segments.src: Its influence usually shows up in the months afterward, as governments act on what they agreed to, or fail to.
segments.tr: Son influence apparaît généralement dans les mois qui suivent, à mesure que les gouvernements agissent sur ce sur quoi ils se sont mis d'accord, ou échouent à le faire.

segments.src: Government borrowing is another major topic.
